impacts.about: What each level at the Rochester Town gauge has meant for the town. Check the VICSES Local Flood Guide and the Rochester Flood Study for street-level detail.

levels.label: Minor flood level
levels.text: Water spreads onto low-lying land beside the river. Homes are not normally affected.

levels.label: Moderate flood level
levels.text: Some minimal impacts on homes begin.

levels.label: Major flood level
levels.text: River water begins to affect the town itself.

levels.label: October 2022 peak
levels.text: Rochester's worst recorded flood, higher than January 2011, when around 80% of the town was inundated. The Northern Highway into town was closed.
